items.condition: The submission changes the 77-atom open-ring molecule, charge, multiplicity or system boundary without documenting a deliberate non-scored control.
The submission reports S1/S2 as final results from an unconverged optimization or without a minimum/endpoint validation record.
The report merges S1 and S2, omits units or orbital identity, or presents values that cannot be mapped to individual states.
The conclusion presents vertical excitations as a proven rate, quantum yield or complete reaction mechanism.
